## P1: Planning and Permits
> Secure permits, finalize layout, and lock in the budget.
- [ ] T1: Finalize budget and contractor estimates (3d) @Priya
- [ ] T2: Prepare architectural and wiring plans for permit submission (1w) @Jordan depends: T1
- [ ] T3: Submit permit application to local building department (1d) @Priya due: 2027-01-15 depends: T2
- [ ] M1: Permit application submitted
- [ ] T4: Wait for permit approval and processing (3w) @Priya depends: T3
  notes: Buffer time for municipal review and potential revisions.

## P2: Procurement and Demolition
> Order materials and clear out the old kitchen workspace.
- [ ] T5: Order new cabinets, countertops, and electrical supplies (1w) @Jordan depends: T1
- [ ] T6: Wait for material fabrication and shipping lead times (2w) @Jordan depends: T5
- [ ] T7: Clear out old kitchen and disconnect existing utilities (2d) @Jordan depends: M1
  - [ ] Remove all appliances and stored items
  - [ ] Shut off water and power to kitchen area
- [ ] T8: Demolish old cabinets, counters, and strip old wiring (3d) @Jordan depends: T7

## P3: Rough-In and Installation
> Install new electrical wiring, cabinets, and countertops.
- [ ] T9: Perform rough-in electrical wiring and inspection prep (4d) @Jordan depends: T8
- [ ] T10: Install new cabinetry (4d) @Jordan depends: T6, T9
- [ ] T11: Template and install new countertops (3d) @Jordan depends: T10
- [ ] M2: Cabinetry and counters installed

## P4: Final Inspection and Handover
> Complete final hookups and pass municipal inspection.
- [ ] T12: Complete final electrical hookups, lighting, and trim (2d) @Jordan depends: T11
- [ ] T13: Schedule and complete final municipal building and electrical inspection (1d) @Priya depends: T12
- [ ] M2: Final inspection passed and project closed out depends: T13
